scope: Simple pair bench inside the full game with a loaded save (original with the function hook off vs candidate with the hook on), 18688 isolated CPU pairs for 36 pending functions of CCam, CHud, ALL pairs equal, pair counts equal to the bank table, passed=true globally, natural "complete" event with state_restored, saves unchanged, configs restored. Each case rebuilds the same deterministic fixture (seed = case index) in both legs and compares the return value, the bytes of the fake objects, the touched global ranges, the x87 control word (24 bits) and the whole trace of doubled collaborators with raw arguments; foreign threads ignored. Traced doubles get NO credit. Only the own part of each function is validated. Source tested == current working tree at registration (class sources match the probe build manifest). Historical evidence approved with explicit limits; no current dependency accreditation. Limits: GXT texts only with characters 0x20..0x7D (never '~', except the '~1~' of SetHelpMessageWithNumber); floats moderate (no Inf, no signalling NaN); fake peds, vehicles (fake vtable, slot 14 = Teleport), RW camera and entity; CFont, CSprite2d, CMessages::AddToPreviousBriefArray, CWaterLevel::GetWaterLevel, CShadows, rand and others doubled with trace. NOT covered by the bank and NOT registered: CHud::Draw, DrawAfterFade, DrawRadar, DrawWeaponIcon, Initialise, Shutdown, CCam::Process_Rocket, CCam::Process_1stPerson (real RenderState table, files/textures, skeletal hierarchy, real world).
